user_clarification_20261023.objective: For each of the 24 low-detail grasses, first acquire one or more actual taxon-verified broad field photos showing whole rooted growth habit and intact flowering head, THEN add different close-ups covering the leaf blade/sheath/collar/ligule and species-diagnostic spikelet anatomy: glumes, fertile/sterile lemmas, awns, bristles, veins, hairy zones and millimeter scale as applicable. Follow with same-angle source-verified look-alikes and accurate arrows visible on real structures.
user_clarification_20261023.photo_selection: No redundant distant seedheads to inflate counts. Optimize distinct diagnostic teaching roles; preserve genuine rights, credits, physically hosted JPEG and same-plant provenance where available.
user_clarification_20261023.publication: Archive vetted GPS-stripped photo bytes into canonical GitHub species images directory and reference them in ordinary public learner species gallery. Do not count remote source links, illustration or metadata as physically stored photos.
user_clarification_20261023.scope: 24 low-detail gallery grasses; this eight-species subset was audited; actual photo acquisition not yet completed.
